title: Scan for identifiers
summary: Find URLs, emails, IPs, dates, phone and long numbers.

inputs.text:
Contact jane@example.org or +61 2 9999 8888 by 2024-03-05.
See https://example.org/a.

sections.use: Check a text for identifier-like patterns before it is shared: URLs, email addresses, IPv4 addresses, dates, phone numbers and long digit runs, with line and column.
sections.exclusions: It finds patterns, not names, places or organisations, and not IPv6 addresses. An empty result is not proof that a text is de-identified.
sections.limitations: Text up to 1 MiB. Counts are exact totals; the findings list stops at 1,000 and truncated says so. Dates are ISO, d/m/y or m/d/y, and English month names.
sections.missing_data: A text without matches gives an empty list and zero counts.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

outputs.out: The findings (kind, value, line, column), exact counts per kind and truncated.
